tag: the cycles surface is built but mounted nowhere
why: The reach failure this plan keeps finding: nothing imported any of the six cycle classes before this round, and a surface that is written but not mounted leaves them exactly as unreached as they were.

tag: a reader that works reports itself unbound
why: Proves the FRESH-BACKEND PROBE can fail, and proves the refusal is not the only state these bindings can reach. A binding that always refuses would pass every honesty leg while measuring nothing — the opposite failure, and just as useless.
